info.title: OMA LwM2M Vendor Specific Measurement Quality Reason (Object ID 510)

Vendor_Specific_Measurement_Quality_Reas.label: Vendor Specific Measurement Quality Reason
Vendor_Specific_Measurement_Quality_Reas.description: This object contains description for vendor specific measurement quality reason codes provided in a Measurement Metadata (509) object. Instances of this object define the mapping of vendor specific reason codes to reason description in the scope of an individual device.

Vendor_Specific_Quality_Reason_Code.label: Vendor Specific Quality Reason Code
Vendor_Specific_Quality_Reason_Code.description:
Measurement quality degradation reason reported by a smart sensor. Reason codes 0-127 are generic reason codes and they are defined in Measurement Metadata object description.
128-511: VENDOR_SPECIFIC_BLOCK Vendor specific block. This block contains vendor specific quality reason codes.
512-1023: RESERVED_VENDOR_BLOCK Reserved vendor specific block. This block is reserved for future use.

Quality_Reason_Name.label: Quality Reason Name
Quality_Reason_Name.description: The name of the quality reason. It is used as a key to find a localized reason description. The name should be concise and unique in the localization scope.

Quality_Reason_Description.label: Quality Reason Description
Quality_Reason_Description.description: Description of the quality reason. This text can be used if a localized version is not found.
